info.title: bucket.proto
info.description:
The bucket datasource: an object store read as a datasource. Its API is its
own — the module publishes no single interface every datasource implements,
because a store that streams and a store that pages cannot share one shape.
What it shares with every other datasource is the vocabulary below: how a
source is named, how an item is described, and how a credential arrives.

get.summary: Describe introduces this datasource to a registry.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: FetchItemRequest asks for one item's bytes.

post.summary: ListItems answers one page of a source's items.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: ListItemsRequest asks for one page of a source's items.

get.summary: Version answers which build is serving.

id.description: id is the access key id, or the Azure storage account name.

secret.description: secret is the secret access key, or the Azure shared key.

v1AccessKey.description: AccessKey is an access key id and its secret.

accessKey.description:
access_key authenticates "s3" and "minio" (access key id and secret
access key) and "azure" (account name and shared key).

accessToken.description:
access_token is a short-lived OAuth2 bearer for "gcs", used as is:
no refresh and no exchange, so an expired one is refused by the
store with the store's own answer.

v1Credential.description:
Credential opens a source for ONE call. It is never persisted, never
returned on any response, and never logged: the host holds custody and hands
one over per call, and this service forgets it when the call returns.

A Google service-account JSON key is deliberately not offered. Key creation
is refused by organization policy, so the only Google credential this
datasource accepts is a short-lived token the caller minted — by service
account impersonation — for this one call.

name.description: name is the datasource's stable identifier within a deployment.

title.description: title is a short human label.

kinds.description: kinds lists the store kinds a source may name.

requiresCredential.description:
requires_credential reports whether a read needs one. A source in a
store that admits anonymous reads does not.

streams.description: streams reports whether items are fetched as a stream rather than whole.

v1DescribeResponse.description:
DescribeResponse is how a datasource introduces itself to a registry that
knows nothing about it. The registry answers its catalog from the composed
datasources' own descriptions, never from a list written down in its source.

item.description: item describes what is being fetched, on the first chunk only.

data.description: data is the next run of bytes.

v1FetchItemChunk.description:
FetchItemChunk is a run of an item's bytes. The first chunk carries the
item it is answering for; the rest carry bytes only.

source.description: source names the bucket to read.

credential.description: credential opens it, for this call only.

key.description: key is the item's key, relative to the source's prefix.

version.description: version, when set, refuses the read if the item no longer carries it.

v1FetchItemRequest.description: FetchItemRequest asks for one item's bytes.

key.description: key is the object's key, relative to the source's prefix.

version.description:
version is opaque: compare it for equality, never order or parse it. An
item whose version is unchanged has not changed.

modifiedAt.description: modified_at is when the store last wrote the object.

contentType.description: content_type is what the store reports, empty when it reports none.

v1Item.description: Item is one object in a source, described in the host's terms.

source.description: source names the bucket to list.

credential.description: credential opens it, for this call only.

limit.description: limit caps the page; zero takes the store's own cap.

pageToken.description: page_token continues a previous page. It is opaque.

v1ListItemsRequest.description: ListItemsRequest asks for one page of a source's items.

items.description: items are the objects in this page.

nextPageToken.description: next_page_token continues the listing, empty when it is complete.

v1ListItemsResponse.description:
ListItemsResponse is one complete page. An empty next_page_token means the
listing finished: a truncated page is never answered as a complete one.

kind.description: kind is the store this source lives in: "s3", "minio", "gcs" or "azure".

endpoint.description:
endpoint is an http(s) origin with no path, query or userinfo. Empty
means the kind's public service; "minio" requires one.

region.description: region signs S3-style requests; empty means the store's default.

bucket.description: bucket is the bucket (S3, MinIO, GCS) or container (Azure).

prefix.description:
prefix confines a read to keys under it, as a literal key prefix. Keys
in requests and results are relative to it.

v1Source.description:
Source names one bucket to read. Every field is non-secret: a source is
configuration a consumer may hold, display and store. The credential that
opens it never appears here.

version.description: version is the service version codefly stamped into this build.

v1VersionResponse.description: VersionResponse carries the serving build's version.
